patch_description:
The fixed trainer uses three data uploads, two independently parameterized ansatz blocks per upload, Adam with a default learning rate of 0.03, 30 minibatch steps per epoch, batch size 15, a 0.90 convergence threshold, and validation-loss early stopping with patience 75 and minimum delta 1e-4.

The seed has 24 unique parameters per block and 146 total parameters. Its line of CZ gates treats endpoint qubits differently, while the terminal RZ layer cannot directly affect the final Z readout. The proposed block instead uses four shared parameters per block, reducing the total to 26. Collective rotations impose a useful graph-like symmetry prior and reduce overfitting, while independent parameter copies across the six blocks preserve data-reuploading flexibility. A regular 3-dimensional cube entangler connects every qubit with equal degree using three parallel perfect matchings, avoiding the endpoint bias and serial depth of the CZ line. The final RY/RX layers convert both phase quadratures generated by IsingZZ encoding into measurable Z populations. This configuration should improve parameter efficiency, reduce the generalization gap, and provide stronger gradients with lower circuit depth.
